description: Adapted TUM LIKE workload: the 17 patterns for upstream TPCH/supplier.s_comment from the DaMoN'26 FSST-LIKE benchmark (https://github.com/calin2110/FSST-LIKE-Matching@b1eb3ab9c63e), stored under the narrowest equivalent op and blessed against OUR column tpch-scomment-sf10 — not an exact reproduction of the paper's data.
